ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'Atrybuty_LastMod' AND xtype = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.Atrybuty_LastMod

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.Atrybuty_LastMod ON CDN.Atrybuty FOR Update , INSERT AS BEGIN UPDATE N SET N.Atr_LastMod = DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1990-01-01',120),GETDATE()) FROM CDN.Atrybuty N join inserted I on N.Atr_Id = I.Atr_Id END
